title: bittorrent: Fix reassembly when header and message type are segmented
description:
Return 0 from get_bittorrent_pdu_length, which tells tcp_dissect_pdus
(and utp_dissect_pdus) that we need one more segment.

Move the keepalive processing up so that it actually happens. Note
that dissect_bittorrent_message will always get at least 4 bytes
thanks to the above functions.

Have bt-utp on such packets throw a FragmentError instead of a
DissectorBug, similar to a change done a while back for TCP.

Fix #19905
